title: Writing --- Four Lines, And The Full Stop That Answers
label: ch:it-four-lines
canDo: I can write four connected lines to a named reader, joining with e and ma and giving a reason with perché, ending that line with a full stop rather than a question mark.

payoff.summary: Complete IT-W262-four-lines: four lines to one reader, at least one joined with e or ma and one with perché, then check the perché line ends with a full stop and its accent rises.
payoff.note: perché is one word for why and because, so on the page only the end mark separates a question from a reason. Its acute accent leans the other way from the grave on è, and one line can hold both.
